description:
Deployment is already a core concept (manifest deployment_modes with local/self-hosted/managed classes, selected with --platform name:deployment, platforms/adapter_factory.py:104-122), but results never record which mode was selected (platform.deployment.deployment_type is guessed from endpoints in platforms/base/runtime_metadata.py:358-389), and several platforms carry their own duplicate keys.

Work:
1. Record platform.deployment.selected (manifest mode name) and selected_class from the factory's resolution.
2. Duplicate keys become deprecated aliases of the selector, with a warning: velox `deployment` (local|remote), lakesail `sail_mode` (local|distributed; currently unregistered and ignored), influxdb `mode` (core|cloud), clickhouse `deployment_mode` and its alias `mode`, firebolt `deployment_mode`/`firebolt_mode`, ducklake `deployment_mode`, pg-duckdb `deployment_mode` (self-hosted|motherduck). Declare any missing modes in the manifest first.
3. Remove the resulting keys from the bare-word grandfather list (ADR D11) and add the deployment section to docs/development/new-platform-acceptance-checklist.md.
4. Docs for each affected platform show --platform name:mode.
